name: logo-lib
title: Logo.dev URL Builder
author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>
description: Typed URL builder, retina srcset helper, and token resolution for the Logo.dev Logo Image API. Supports domain, name, ticker, crypto, and ISIN lookups.
docs: Get a free publishable (pk_) key at https://www.logo.dev/dashboard and set NEXT_PUBLIC_LOGO_DEV_TOKEN in .env.local.
